text:
Aisha: FYI we got a customer escalation from BetaRetail — rerank endpoint returning different scores after yesterday's model push. They provided the same query+candidates and scores changed by ~0.18 on average. :worried:

Tom: Can you paste the original request and the two responses (pre/post)? Need exact inputs to repro tokenization/formatting effects.

Aisha: Pasting minimal repro below (sanitized):

Aisha: ```json
{
  \"query\": \"running shoes for flat feet\",
  \"candidates\": [\"red stability shoe - mens\", \"blue trail shoe - womens\", \"neutral walking shoe - unisex\"]
}
```

Aisha: Post-deploy scores (v2026-03-11.1): [0.62, 0.31, 0.07]
Aisha: Last-known-good (v2026-03-08): [0.45, 0.40, 0.15]

Santiago: That's a pretty large redistribution. Quick checks: Was the dedupe/normalization hook changed? Any tokenizer updates?

Tom: I checked model bundle diff: only change was updated attention kernel fallback and a small whitespace-normalizer in preprocessing (PR #842). The normalizer strips repeated spaces and lowercases. Shouldn't cause rank flips this big but could affect phrase separation.

Joni: I ran the customer's exact payload against both pinned model variants in our local test env: I see same numbers Aisha pasted. Repro is consistent on my machine.

Aisha: Customer reports they hit this at scale after we rolled across region-us-west-2.

ops-bot: deploy-bot reported: deployment v2026-03-11.1 completed on us-west-2 at 1792141000 :white_check_mark:

Tom: Can you attach raw logits or score traces from the runtime for a single request? Specifically the per-candidate score before softmax (or whatever scoring op we use).

Santiago: Pulling logs — one thing stands out: the rerank service applied a new token limit enforcement that truncates long candidate strings at 128 tokens (previously 256). For these candidates length isn't large but combined prefix+candidate length changed due to whitespace normalizer. Grabbed a single request trace:```
INPUT_TOKENS: [12, 34, 56, ...]
SCORE_PRE: [1.45, 0.72, 0.23]
SCORE_POST: [0.95, 0.48, 0.08]
MODEL_VARIANT: v2026-03-11.1
NORMALIZER: enabled
TRUNCATED: no
```

Tom: Pre vs post raw scores look scaled down but relative ordering changed. Could be temperature or softmax stability change due to kernel fallback subtlety. Any change to scale of logits?

Santiago: Kernel fallback swapped GEMM implementation on Ampere nodes: float32 accumulation -> mixed precision path for some ops. We had an internal note about reduced dynamic range on very small logit differences.

Joni: I compared tokenization of the candidate strings between variants. The new normalizer changed "-" spacing for product names so tokens merged differently: e.g., "stability shoe - mens" tokenized to [stability, shoe-mens] vs [stability, shoe, -, mens] previously. That can significantly change pairwise scores.

Aisha: Customer expects determinism: same inputs -> same ordering. They asked for root cause and mitigation (rollback or config).

Tom: Proposed immediate actions: 1) pin customer to last-known-good model variant (v2026-03-08) via per-customer routing; 2) run a quick A/B on a small sample with both tokenizers to measure drift; 3) if tokenizer change is the culprit, add an option to preserve legacy normalization for rerank endpoint.

Santiago: I can add a runtime flag to force legacy normalizer for that customer's requests. Low-risk quick fix. Also will run a regression suite on 5k saved queries from the customer to confirm.

Aisha: Can you add repro steps so CS can tell the customer what we tried? I'll include logs and timeline.

Tom: Repro steps:
1) Use the exact payload above.
2) Call rerank endpoint with header `X-Model-Version: v2026-03-08` -> record scores.
3) Call rerank endpoint with header `X-Model-Version: v2026-03-11.1` -> record scores.
4) If difference > 0.05 on avg, capture raw logits from runtime trace via `GET /internal/traces?req_id=<id>` (requires ops key).

Tom: Example curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Model-Version: v2026-03-11.1" \ 
  -d '{"query":"running shoes for flat feet","candidates":["red stability shoe - mens","blue trail shoe - womens","neutral walking shoe - unisex"]}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank
```

Joni: I also created a small unit test that diffs tokenization between normalizer versions and logs merged tokens. Running it on customer samples now.

ops-bot: ops alert: customer BetaRetail (acct-retail-123) escalated to SEV-2 at 1792146500 :rotating_light:

Aisha: For immediate customer-facing messaging: sorry, investigating; we can pin you to previous model while we validate. Offering no-cost rollback window. Want to send that?

Tom: Yes, offer pin + we will run regression and share findings within 48 hours. SRE please confirm runtime flag for legacy normalizer.

Santiago: Flag deployed to canary; tested on 50 requests — matches v2026-03-08 scores. I'll roll to customer routing and monitor.

Aisha: Thanks team. I'll reply to BetaRetail with timeline and the repro steps. Will follow up once the 5k-run completes. :thumbsup:

Joni: Follow-up note — potential long-term fix: ensure tokenizer/normalizer changes are part of model compatibility checks and add a post-deploy rerank-regression gate using customer-critical queries.

Tom: Agreed. I'll draft an RFC for pre-rollout compatibility tests for rerank workloads.

Aisha: Closing loop here later. Keeping thread open until rollback confirmed and customer satisfied.
